research_scope: Base-game character/mentor/PQ skills selected from uncovered canonical identities after duplicate checking against the current repository.

verification_audit.method: Each identity was checked against the current repository before addition, then reconciled against current Xenoverse 2 skill references and, where available, a second independent research source. Exact drop percentages are preserved only where explicitly documented.

records.name: Dodoria Headbutt
records.skill_description: Charge forward head-first. On hit, the attack breaks the opponent's guard and permits a rapid transition into an Ultimate Attack.
records.mechanics_notes: The current skill reference classifies Dodoria Headbutt as a Strike Super with a charge, guard-break, knockback, and long recovery. A miss leaves the user exposed for an extended recovery animation; a successful hit can be canceled into an Ultimate Attack.
records.combo_notes: Its principal conversion property is the immediate Ultimate transition after a successful hit. The long whiff recovery makes confirms important.
records.pve_notes: Useful as a guard-break route against AI when the charge can be safely confirmed.
records.pvp_notes: The guard-break and Ultimate-cancel properties create a meaningful confirm route, but the long miss recovery is a major risk.

records.name: Earth Splitting Galick Gun
records.character_source: Vegeta; Perfect Cell; Future Trunks; Vegeta (Super Saiyan 4) (Customize Partner); Vegeta (Super Saiyan God) (Customize Partner); Gogeta (Super Saiyan 4) (Customize Partner)
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 11, 'Burst Open and Mix!'; later available to applicable Customize Partners after purchase
records.skill_description: A more powerful, uncharged Galick Gun variant that fires a large multi-hit purple beam at the target.
records.mechanics_notes: The current skill reference lists a 200 Ki cost and a maximum 23-hit beam. The move cannot be charged and is intended as a stronger but more expensive Galick Gun variant. The PQ research record documents a 50% Ultimate Finish reward slot for PQ11.
records.combo_notes: The fast firing animation makes it suitable after knockbacks or restands where a longer charge would be unreliable.
records.pve_notes: The higher Ki cost is offset by its immediate multi-hit beam and stronger output relative to the basic Galick Gun.
records.pvp_notes: Its quick release can punish spacing after a confirmed knockback, while the two-bar Ki cost must be budgeted carefully.

records.name: Milky Cannon
records.skill_description: Fires a Ki Blast projectile that moves quickly at first and then slows, with charge length changing the distance at which it slows.
records.mechanics_notes: The current skill reference classifies Milky Cannon as a chargeable, mid-to-long-range Ki Blast Super. The projectile travels quickly for a short distance, then moves slowly for several seconds; charging increases its initial travel distance. A successful hit knocks the target back.
records.combo_notes: Its unusual slow-travel phase can be used to control space and alter the timing of a projectile approach.
records.pve_notes: The lingering projectile path can help control AI movement and create delayed-hit pressure.
records.pvp_notes: Variable travel distance gives the move a timing mix-up, but the projectile's predictable slow phase can be defended against by experienced opponents.

records.name: Recoome Kick
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 61, 'The Cell Games Continued'; later available through applicable Customize Partner purchase
records.skill_description: A fast flying knee/side-kick that increases the user's basic attack temporarily when it connects.
records.mechanics_notes: The current skill reference lists Recoome Kick as a Strike Super with a single-hit rush property and 100 Ki cost. The documented effect is a temporary basic-attack boost on successful connection.
records.combo_notes: The attack combines a forward dash with a single-hit strike and can be used as a pressure or conversion tool when its startup is covered.
records.pve_notes: The temporary basic-attack boost gives it utility beyond its immediate strike damage, especially in sustained AI encounters.
records.pvp_notes: Its reward is tied to landing the skill because the temporary basic-attack increase matters only after a successful connection.

records.name: Time Control
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 18, 'Force Entrance Exam'; Ultimate Finish reward
records.skill_description: Freezes the targeted enemy in place inside a time-control effect for a short duration.
records.mechanics_notes: The current skill reference classifies Time Control as an Other Super with a stun property and 100 Ki cost. The user takes a stance and freezes the enemy for no longer than a few seconds. The PQ18 research record documents a 40% Ultimate Finish reward slot.
records.combo_notes: The primary purpose is to create a temporary stun window for a follow-up rather than to deal direct damage.
records.pve_notes: The short-duration immobilization can create setup opportunities against AI, especially when the target is otherwise difficult to pin down.
records.pvp_notes: Its stun utility makes timing and matchup knowledge important; the cast itself remains vulnerable if used without a safe opening.
